meaning: Failed ignition. After four failed attempts the control enters one-hour lockout (10).
causes: Flame sense rod dirty or not connected
Igniter not working, not connected or mispositioned
Flame not spreading from first burner to the last
diySteps: Make sure the gas valve is turned on
Technician: clean or replace flame sense rod; check its wiring and furnace ground
Technician: replace or reposition igniter; check manifold pressure (~3.5" WC natural gas, ~10" WC LP)
Technician: replace burner or control if indicated
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the gas valve is on and ignition still fails.
